Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 02-Dec-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. END SEMESTER DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER / DECEMBER 2024  
  SUBJECT: ECE 2124/ECE_2124 - DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN  
  DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN [ECE 2124]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Implement 4 bit BCD to excess-3 code converter circuit using basic gates.                               (4)  
1B)               Implement a 2-bit equality detector using a 4:1 multiplexer and additional gates.                       (3)  
1C)               Implement 4 to 16 decoder using 3 to 8 decoders with active low enable input signal.                    (3)  
2A)               Design a 4 bit ripple carry adder/subtractor using full adder and necessary gates. Explain the          (4)  
  working principle with suitable examples.  
2B)               Design an asynchronous up-counter using positive edge-triggered JK flip-flops to divide the input       (3)  
  frequency by 8, with wave forms for the clock and flip-flop outputs.  
2C)               Design a self-starting counter using positive edge triggered D flip-flop to generate the sequence 1,    (3)  
  2, 5, 7 and repeat. Avoid lock-out issue by forcing the unused states 0 to 1, 3 and 4 to 5, 6 to 7.  
3A)               Design a sequential circuit using Mealy machine that can detect the overlapping sequence 1001           (4)  
  using negative edge triggered D flipflops  
3B)               Convert D flip-flop to JK flip-flop.                                                                    (3)  
3C)               A staircase light is controlled by two switches, one is at the top of the stairs and the other at the (3)  
  bottom of the stairs. Light is ON when and only when one of the switch is ON and the other switch is  
  OFF. Make a truth table for this system and implement this using behavioural Verilog code using  
  case condition.  
4A)               Write structural Verilog code for full adder with two half adder modules and logical gates.             (4)  
4B)               Write dataflow Verilog code for the 2:4 decoder with active low enable and active high output.          (3)  
4C)               Write the Verilog code for 3 input NOR gate using User defined primitive.                               (3)  
5A)               Implement full subtractor using ACT-2 FPGA.                                                             (4)  
5B)               Explain ASIC design flow with neat diagram.                                                             (3)  
5C)               Explain the following gate parameters.                                                                  (3)  
  a) Noise margin  
  b) Propagation delay  
  c) Fan in  
  
  
  -----End-----  
  
  
  Page 1 of 1
